assertions.note: `learn-search.test.ts` confirmed tracked symlinks are skipped and the outside marker is not searchable.
Same harness asserted `skippedSymlinks === 1` in learn JSON output.
`printOutput` redacted userinfo, query params, and fragment params in text and JSON output.
Offline web ingest kept raw secret substrings out of SQLite locator fields.
Remote git ingest redacted credentials in outputs, SQLite, and cache config.
`rebuild.test.ts` returned non-zero for partial success and included per-source failures.
Failed rebuild state persisted with `lastRebuildStatus=failed`, error, and attempts.
Doctor reported degraded health when a manifest failed.
Custom offline harness showed `db doctor` reporting `healthStatus=degraded` and `rebuildReason='embedding fingerprint changed'` for a valid fingerprint mismatch.
Fingerprint-mismatch guard blocked `db rebuild --source` with a stable error.
Fingerprint-mismatch guard blocked `db rebuild --failed-only` with a stable error.
Partial rebuild failure left the index degraded and preserved failed manifests.
`db doctor --project --json` in an empty directory returned `dbExists=false` and did not create a project DB.
`db doctor` left the main DB unchanged but created `index.sqlite-wal` and `index.sqlite-shm` sidecars, so the command is not side-effect free on disk.
Offline harness showed `autoRebuildIfNeeded` returning `rebuildTriggered=true` and the rebuilt DB fingerprint matching the new config dimensions.
Default search left `extensions=[]` and returned hits for both marker files.
`--ext TS` normalized to `.ts` and filtered results strictly by suffix.
`ai-search` propagated structured-output fallback successfully when JSON mode was rejected.
`bun run smoke:google` ran end-to-end and exited 0; output stayed secret-safe and reported `status=passed`.

commandsRun.observation: All safety/search assertions in these files passed.
`db-doctor.test.ts` failed on the read-only case because `db doctor` created WAL/SHM sidecars; the rebuild assertions otherwise passed.
AI search fallback and smoke-runner unit tests passed.
Validated fingerprint-mismatch doctor reporting, confirmed read-only side effects, and verified auto rebuild rewrites the fingerprint.
Real smoke ran successfully with a present Google API key and did not leak the key value.

frictions.description: `db doctor` read-only verification was timing-sensitive with WAL/SHM sidecars, so I used a custom offline harness and normalized the temp sidecars before comparing hashes.
frictions.resolution: Compared the main DB file hash plus read-only state before/after doctor, and then recorded the WAL/SHM sidecar creation as the failure signal.

frictions.description: The initial mismatch config edit used an invalid embedding dimensionality, which caused config loading to fall back instead of reporting the mismatch.
frictions.resolution: Changed the temp config to a schema-valid dimensionality (128) before rerunning the mismatch validation.

smoke.observation: Passed end-to-end with `status=passed`; output did not contain the literal API key value.

summary: Validated 19 assertions: 18 passed and 1 failed (`VAL-DB-021`, because `db doctor` creates WAL/SHM sidecars on disk).
